simple.meaning: רֶתַח (rethach) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a boiling.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.

definitions.full: H7571. rethach [ רֶ֫תַח ] noun [masculine] boiling ; — plural suffix רְתָחֶיהָ Ezek 24:5 , as accusative of congnate meaning with verb cause its boilings to boil , make it boil vigorously; but read נְתָחֶיהָ Hi-Sm Co Da (possibly) and all modern (compare 24:4 ; 24:6 ; || עצמים ).
